trends.name: Nvidia Leadership Crisis & AI Sector Uncertainty
sources: Nvidia: Jensen's Resignation Is Worse Than It Looks

trends.summary: Nvidia's leadership turmoil, particularly Jensen Huang's departure and associated scandals, has created extreme volatility and raises questions about the stability of the entire $500 billion AI financing thesis. Investors are reassessing the fundamental valuations and operational risks within the semiconductor sector.

trends.name: Federal Reserve Policy and Rate Guidance

trends.summary: The Fed's policy communication is shifting, implying less granular focus on specific future rate votes. Market participants are anxiously awaiting clear guidance on the trajectory of rate cuts and when monetary tightening risks have truly passed.
